originality.rationale: The accessible full 2026 Xue paper covers arbitrary convex bodies only for rank <=2; its equality remark is known in that range. The current statement extends to coordinate-subgroup ranks >=3 under unconditionality and gives a complete all-rank coordinate-box equality characterization, not implied by Xue rank bound. Malikiosis introduced the criterion but not this sufficient condition. Targeted semantic/primary searches found no equivalent. Earlier order-ideal literature is a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed earlier exact theorem on congruence images of absolute downsets or product stochastic order could establish the same result.
Only coordinate subgroups are covered; the proof does not imply arbitrary higher-rank DMP.
